name: SkyCity Auckland
verdict: Auckland casino and entertainment complex of SkyCity Entertainment Group, listed in New Zealand and Australia. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: listed as 'Sky City', official supplier of the Black Foils; the SailGP team page links the logo to skycityauckland.co.nz (fetched 2026-09-30). SkyCity Entertainment Group's Annual Report 2026 lists three substantial product holders as at 30 June 2026: Allan Gray Group 12.55%, Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC) 11.84% and AustralianSuper 8.32%. ACC is a New Zealand Crown entity; New Zealand has no record of serious abuses in the dataset, and state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md). No other state or state fund is among the substantial holders. Company test: SkyCity's regulator actions are anti-money-laundering cases (Federal Court of Australia, A$67m, June 2024; High Court of New Zealand, NZ$4.16m, 2024) and gambling-licence cases about harm minimisation (a five-day closure of the Auckland casino agreed with the Department of Internal Affairs in July 2024; an A$21m fine agreed with South Australia's Liquor and Gambling Commissioner in June 2026, which also covers anti-money-laundering failures). These are financial and consumer-protection matters, not findings of forced or child labour, deaths or injuries, discrimination or abuse of communities, so they do not count under METHOD.md.
